turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

"Mr. Hale." *She stays standing, bag still on her shoulder.* "I have until twenty to five. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Nobody called me. So before anything else: who decided on the zero, and when?"
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.

*She sets her bag down on a student desk, slowly, and looks at the phone.*

"Fine. Then say the date and time into it, and who's present." *Beat.* "I'll want a copy. Today, by email."

*She takes out her own phone, sets it face-up beside his.*

"Now. Who decided on the zero, and when?"
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

"I haven't mentioned legal action." *Flat. She doesn't sit.* "You brought it up. Why?"

*She lets that sit a second.*

"I asked a question about procedure. Who decided on the zero, and when? You haven't answered it."

"I always do." *She pulls out the desk chair, sits, and keeps her coat on.* "Choose your words carefully. Noted. That's on the recording."

"You asked for this meeting, Mr. Hale. So tell me what happened. Start with when the checker flagged the essay, and when Owen was told."
